messages:
Sam P: FYI — Sales just forwarded a formal request from Deltacorp. They want Redwood Private with VPC + on‑prem air‑gap, BYO‑HSM (PKCS#11), strict egress denylist, and SOC2 evidence. They need a timeline + acceptance criteria to move to contract. Link to request: https://drive.redwood/deltacorp-request :eyes:
Isha S: Quick context — customer hoping to go prod in ~Oct 2026, will consider a dedicated commitment if we can guarantee latency and a 99.9% SLA. Budget is a conversation but procurement expects a clear delivery plan.
Mira (Solutions): What I need to map to backlog: exact HSM vendor, whether they want managed control plane or local-only control plane, and their network topology (peer, transit, firewall rules, maintenance windows, NATing). Also confirm whether remote hands/site access is available for initial bring-up.
Jon E (Eng): Engineering notes: packaging private distro for air‑gapped site + HSM integration (PKCS#11) + ensuring parity with our hosted runtime (quantization kernels, KV cache behavior) — big items. Rough effort: 6–8w for packaging/testing + 4w for security hardening/validation. Blockers: airgap CI (we need test harness that can run offline), HSM lab for QA, and telemetry gating.
Tara (Security): Security asks: list HSM vendor + key management flow, threat model for on‑prem control plane, pen test window, SOC2 artifacts requested, and explicit outbound endpoints allowed. If they want telemetry back to Redwood, we need signed telemetry exception and dataflow diagram.
Sam P: To be explicit, propose these launch/acceptance criteria before moving to backlog: 1) Signed SOW with ops hours and support SLA 2) Network runbook + approved firewall rules 3) HSM/KMS vendor confirmed and test keys available 4) Onsite/remote hands plan for initial provisioning 5) Acceptance test results: throughput >= X rps, median token latency < Y ms, and end‑to‑end auth + audit log verification.
Isha S: Sales asks for a customer‑facing rough timeline today. Can we give a band? They need something to attach to procurement. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jon E (Eng): Ballpark: from kickoff to production ~10–12 engineer‑weeks + ~2 weeks for onsite setup/config (depends on customer infra readiness). If we have HSM keys and network access day 0, we could compress to ~8–10 weeks. Caveat: airgap CI and integration test time can add slippage.
Mira (Solutions): I'll draft the intake checklist and a one‑pager for Sales to share (network inventory, HSM details, control plane choice, maintenance windows, test account). Will schedule a 60m intake call with their infra/security leads — propose Thu this week.
Tara (Security): I'll compile required docs (SOC2 excerpts, pen test scope, allowed endpoints list) and a minimal security questionnaire we can send prior to the call.
Sam P: Actions agreed: Mira -> schedule intake call this week; Jon -> produce minimal acceptance test matrix (latency/throughput/auth/audit) by EOD Wed; Tara -> security doc list by Wed; Isha -> send customer the one‑pager once Mira drafts it. I'll create the backlog/feasibility ticket and tag owners.
jira-bot: Created ticket PROD-4821: "Private Deploy — Deltacorp intake & feasibility" (assignee: Sam P). https://jira.redwood/browse/PROD-4821 :white_check_mark:
Isha S: Thank you — if we can get that one‑pager + timeline today, I can keep procurement warm.
Sam P: Noted. Mira — drop the draft in this thread when ready and @Isha.
Mira (Solutions): Will do. Draft coming in ~2 hours. :calendar:
